newsitem.title: USA: La Jolla Pharm, Abbott in pact.
newsitem.headline: La Jolla Pharm, Abbott in pact.

text.p: La Jolla Pharmaceutical Co said it established an alliance with Abbott Laboratories for the worldwide development and marketing of LJP's compound to treat 1upus, LJP 394.

Abbott and LJP will jointly develop the drug, currently in Phase II/III clinical trials, and is designed to reduce the levels of double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) antibodies which are believed to be responsible for lupus nephritis (kidney disease).
The agreement provides for a total investment of over $50 million by Abbott in license, equity and milestone payments plus funding for future development.
